verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe team comments for privately discussing an email with teammates directly in Shortwave. They also describe @mentions that give the mentioned teammate access to both the comment and the email itself, which addresses the 'instead of forwarding copies' goal. The changelog separately confirms 'add comments for your team.' Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the commenting/@mention workflow, and no detail on side-thread UX such as notifications or comment threading.
